brief:
Shehab Wire (EN) reported that Palestinians commemorated the 14th anniversary of Operation Pillar of Defense, the 2008 military confrontation that began following the assassination of Hamas commander Ahmed al-Jaabari. The operation marked a pivotal moment in Palestinian resistance history and the trajectory of confrontation with Israeli occupation.

The anniversary fell on a date marking a major escalation in Palestinian-Israeli military engagement during the conflict.

title: Palestinians mark 14 years since Operation Pillar of Defense
